messages:
asha_csm: Hi team, Asha here  starting as CSM today. I'm blocked on Salesforce (SSO/403), Aircall (no extension), and I can't access the Confluence customer playbooks. Who handles the app bundle for CSMs?

mike_ops: welcome @asha_csm! tag me. Did you click the "Request apps" button in the quickstart checklist? sometimes that step gets missed.

asha_csm: I did the checklist but I see a redirect to IdP and then '403 Forbidden'. Aircall desktop shows 'no extension assigned'. Confluence link returns 401.

mike_ops: thanks. looping in identity and licensing bots to create tickets so it's traceable. @identity-bot @licensing-bot can you open an access ticket for asha_csm: Salesforce(CSM role), Aircall(extension), Confluence(/sales/cs-playbooks)

identity-bot: Ticket created: IT-3005  "Access: asha_csm  Salesforce + Aircall + Confluence". Assigned: mike_ops-admin. ETA 2 business hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-3005

liz_saleslead: hey @asha_csm welcome!! while ops sorts the tickets, DM me if you want the customer churn playbook PDF and the pricing-grid cheat sheet. I can also add you to the weekly CSM sync invite.

asha_csm: thanks @liz_saleslead. yes please add me to the CSM sync and DM the cheat sheet. Also quick Q  where's the standard voicemail template for CSM outreach? We have a slightly different one for renewal outreach.

liz_saleslead: voicemail for CSMs (renewals): `Hi, this is [Name] from Redwood Inference. I'm calling about your upcoming renewal and a quick health-check. Please leave a time that works or reply to the email I sent and I'll follow up.` short and to-the-point.

licensing-bot: IT-3005 update: Salesforce role mapping missing for 'CSM'. Applied AE+CSM composite mapping. Aircall license queued. Confluence group invite pending.

asha_csm: I also need access to the demo sandbox credentials for product walkthroughs. Is that part of the same ticket or different?

mike_ops: demo sandbox is a separate provisioning step (security review). I'll request demo access in IT-3005 as a subtask and CC the demos team.

identity-bot: IT-3005 status: In progress. Demo access requested (subtask). Aircall license assigned (EXT-5582) but routing profile needs 'CSM-Queue' applied.

licensing-bot: IT-3005 update: Confluence invite sent to asha_csm; folder '/sales/cs-playbooks' shared. Aircall routing profile applied. Salesforce login re-tested  access granted. Ticket pending closure after demo subtask.

asha_csm: I can confirm Confluence and Salesforce work now. Aircall desktop logged in and EXT-5582 is present. Thank you! One more ask: can someone point me to the customer success 30-60-90 template and the health score playbook?

liz_saleslead: 30-60-90: https://redwood.example.com/cs/30-60-90 (internal). Health score playbook in the drive: /sales/cs/health-playbooks. Pinned in #cs-playbooks too. Added you to the calendar invite for CSM sync.

onboarding-bot: Welcome DM sent to asha_csm with quickstart checklist, playbook links, and 1:1 booking: https://cal.com/redwood/cs-30

mike_ops: closing IT-3005 now that demo subtask is routed to demos team. If demo access needs expedite, ping me and i'll prioritize. Welcome aboard @asha_csm! :tada:
